title: A LLM-Based Ranking Method for the Evaluation of Automatic Counter-Narrative Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the quality of LLM-generated counter-narratives against hate speech targeting Muslims (Islamophobia) and Jewish people using the CONAN and MT-CONAN datasets via a pairwise rank-based LLM evaluation (JudgeLM) and human assessment.

Evaluating the effectiveness of models in generating counter-narratives against hate speech targeting individuals with disabilities using the MT-CONAN dataset and tournament-style pairwise LLM judgments.
Evaluating the effectiveness of models in generating counter-narratives against hate speech targeting the LGBT+ community using the MT-CONAN dataset and tournament-style pairwise LLM judgments.
Evaluating the effectiveness of models in generating counter-narratives against hate speech targeting migrants using the MT-CONAN dataset and tournament-style pairwise LLM judgments.
Evaluating the effectiveness of models in generating counter-narratives against hate speech targeting people of color using the MT-CONAN dataset and tournament-style pairwise LLM judgments.
Evaluating the effectiveness of models in generating counter-narratives against hate speech targeting women using the MT-CONAN dataset and tournament-style pairwise LLM judgments.
